description_en: Queries a list of created DHCP options sets by calling the ListDhcpOptionsSets operation
description_zh: 调用ListDhcpOptionsSets接口查询已创建的DHCP选项集列表
kebab_example: aliyun vpc list-dhcp-options-sets --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --max-results 10 --domain-name example.com --dhcp-options-set-name test --dhcp-options-set-id dopt-o6w0df4epg9zo8isy0000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmxazb4ph0000 --tags Value=FinanceJoshua Key=FinanceDept --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListDhcpOptionsSets

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the DHCP options sets that you want to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
要查询DHCP选项集所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The pagination token. Valid values:
If this is the first query or no subsequent query is required, leave this parameter empty.
If a subsequent query is required, set the value to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为10
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The hostname suffix, such as example.com.

After the DHCP options set is associated with a VPC, the hostname suffix is automatically synchronized to the ECS instances in the associated VPC
parameters.help_zh:
主机名后缀，例如example.com。

DHCP选项集关联VPC后，会自动将主机名后缀同步给VPC中ECS实例
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the DHCP options set.

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
parameters.help_zh:
DHCP选项集的名称。

名称长度为1~128个字符，以英文大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-）
parameters.name: dhcp_options_set_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DHCP options set. You can specify up to 20 DHCP options set IDs
parameters.help_zh: DHCP选项集的ID。最多支持输入20个DHCP选项集的ID
parameters.name: dhcp_options_set_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the DHCP options set belongs
parameters.name: resource_group_id

fields.help_en:
The tag key of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag keys. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签键。最多支持输入20个标签键。如需传入该值，则不能输入空字符串。

一个标签键最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The tag value of the resource. You can specify up to 20 tag values. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
fields.help_zh:
资源的标签值。最多支持输入20个标签值。如需传入该值，可以输入空字符串。

最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`
fields.name: value

schema.description_en:

If NextToken is empty, no subsequent query exists.

schema.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

items.description_en: The list of DHCP options sets

AssociateVpcCount.description_en: The number of VPCs associated with the DHCP options set

DomainNameServers.description_en: The IP address of the DNS server

Ipv6LeaseTime.description_en:
The lease time of the IPv6 DHCP options set.

If the lease time is in hours, the unit is h. Valid values: 24h to 1176h and 87600h to 175200h. Default value: 24h.

If the lease time is in days, the unit is d. Valid values: 1d to 49d and 3650d to 7300d. Default value: 1d
Ipv6LeaseTime.description_zh:
IPv6 DHCP选项集的租赁时间。

租赁时间设置为小时时，单位：h。取值范围：24h~1176h，87600h~175200h。   默认值：24h。

租赁时间设置为天时，单位：d。取值范围： 1d~49d，3650d~7300d。   默认值：1d

LeaseTime.description_en:
The lease time of the IPv4 DHCP options set.

If the lease time is in hours, the unit is h. Valid values: 24h to 1176h and 87600h to 175200h. Default value: 87600h.

If the lease time is in days, the unit is d. Valid values: 1d to 49d and 3650d to 7300d. Default value: 3650d
LeaseTime.description_zh:
IPv4 DHCP选项集的租赁时间。

租赁时间设置为小时时，单位：h。取值范围：24h~1176h，87600h~175200h。   默认值：87600h。

租赁时间设置为天时，单位：d。取值范围： 1d~49d，3650d~7300d。   默认值：3650d
